zhnarrator.voice.confirm.title: Set up voice answers?
zhnarrator.voice.confirm.message: You will answer some questions by speaking into your microphone. A small helper program does the listening on your computer, in its own window. The first start downloads about 1.5 GB (Python, PyTorch and a speech recognition model) into .minecraft/learn-or-die and takes several minutes. Your voice never leaves your computer. When your system asks, allow the helper window to use the microphone.
zhnarrator.voice.first_start: The voice helper is setting up in its own window. The first start downloads about 1.5 GB and can take several minutes: keep that window open. I will tell you when it is ready.
zhnarrator.voice.starting: Starting the voice helper in its own window…
zhnarrator.voice.ready: Voice answers are ready. When a spoken question appears, hold %s and say the phrase.
zhnarrator.voice.failed: The voice helper could not start: %s
zhnarrator.voice.timeout: The voice helper did not come up. Look at its window for an error.
zhnarrator.voice.unsupported: Voice answers need Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), Linux, or a Mac with Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer.
zhnarrator.voice.offer.title: Learn or Die: set up voice answers?
zhnarrator.voice.hint: Want to answer by voice? Press %s → Voice answers: set up… It downloads about 1.5 GB once, then works offline.
zhnarrator.voice.not_running: The voice helper is not running. Open the settings (%s) and press Voice answers, or set Quiz to mixed or choice.
